infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Blind Guide uses your location to drop a pin where you're standing, so you can save a hunting spot without hunting for it on a map.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Blind Guide uses the camera so you can photograph a blind or a harvest and attach it to your log.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Blind Guide needs access to your photos so you can attach existing pictures to a hunt or a blind.
